blogs.title: How QLoRA Turns a 65‑Billion‑Parameter Model Into a One‑GPU Wonder
blogs.description: Demystify the core breakthroughs that let you finetune a 65 B LLM on a single 48 GB GPU—4‑bit NormalFloat quantization, double quantization, and paged optimizers—and why this matters for the future of accessible AI.

blogs.title: The Genius of NF4: Why NormalFloat Beats Traditional 4‑bit Formats
blogs.description: Explore the information‑theoretic foundation of NF4, how it aligns perfectly with normally distributed neural weights, and see real‑world benchmarks showing it outperforms Float4 and Int4 in both inference and finetuning.

blogs.title: QLoRA vs. Full Finetuning: Is There a Performance Gap?
blogs.description: Delve into the rigorous comparisons between QLoRA‐trained models and their full‑precision counterparts across GLUE, Super‑NaturalInstructions, MMLU, and more to discover why QLoRA can recover every bit of lost accuracy.

blogs.title: Guanaco: Open‑Source Chatbot Near Matching ChatGPT on the Vicuna Benchmark
blogs.description: Follow the story of Guanaco—a family of 7/13/33/65 B LLMs trained with QLoRA on OASST1—and learn how they achieve over 99 % of ChatGPT’s performance while being torchable on a consumer GPU.

blogs.title: Evaluating Chatbots with Elo Ratings: A Fairer Way to Compare Models
blogs.description: Learn how tournament‑style Elo scoring built on human and GPT‑4 judgments outperforms raw numeric benchmarks, what this says about current evaluation practices, and how it can guide future chatbot research.

blogs.title: Beyond Benchmarks: Qualitative Lessons from Guanaco’s Real‑World Conversations
blogs.description: See real examples where Guanaco shines or fails—fact recall, suggestibility, math problems, theory of mind—and what these ‘lemons’ and ‘cherries’ reveal about training data quality versus model size.
